author: jtraglia
content:
Hey <@&1557338191604748319> I'm creating a new thread (following up from https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1557047083939143701) to discuss which EIPs should go into devnets for the consensus layer specifically. I would like to discuss this here async and try to make a decision at the upcoming ACDT meeting. To kick things off, I propose the following:

* Aim to launch the next devnet October 28th with at least 3 clients.
* Name it `heze-devnet-0` instead of `focil-devnet-2`.
* Include FOCIL + all currently CFI'd features (8015, 8198, 8365).
* If that's too much, make 8198 optional by keeping 12 second slots.

Yes, this will be difficult but it's possible. 8365 should be very easy. 8015 will be annoying but straightforward. 8198 is a bit contentious, but including it in heze sooner should make prototyping/testing easier in the long run. This devnet does not need to be launched before devcon, but it would be cool to see. These EIPs are fairly independent of each other, so it should be clear where bugs are.
